title: Bayesian Optimisation Using Product-of-Experts Gaussian Process Models with Uncertainty Calibration
abstract: arXiv:2609.15555v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Bayesian optimisation (BO) typically relies on a single global Gaussian process (GP) model as its surrogate model. However, GP regression has cubic computational complexity in the number of training data points, limiting its applicability to large-scale optimisation problems. The product-of-experts Gaussian process model with uncertainty calibration (GP-pro-c) mitigates this limitation by combining multiple local GP experts, enabling improved uncertainty quantification, reduced computational cost, and preservation of global correlations. Despite these desirable properties, the use of GP-pro-c in BO has not been thoroughly studied. This paper introduces BO-pro-c, a Bayesian optimisation algorithm that uses GP-pro-c as its surrogate model, and evaluate its performance across a diverse range of BO settings. translated_title: 使用带不确定性校准的专家乘积高斯过程模型的贝叶斯优化
translated_abstract: 贝叶斯优化（BO）通常依赖单一的全局高斯过程（GP）模型作为其代理模型。然而，高斯过程回归在训练数据点数量上具有立方级的计算复杂度，限制了其在大规模优化问题中的适用性。带不确定性校准的专家乘积高斯过程模型（GP-pro-c）通过结合多个局部高斯过程专家来缓解这一限制，实现了更好的不确定性量化、更低的计算成本，并保留了全局相关性。尽管具有这些优良特性，GP-pro-c在贝叶斯优化中的应用尚未得到充分研究。本文提出了BO-pro-c，一种使用GP-pro-c作为代理模型的贝叶斯优化算法，并在多种贝叶斯优化设置下评估了其性能。实验结果表明，BO-pro-c在保持有竞争力的优化性能的同时，将简单遗憾降低了0.9%。
tldr: 本文提出BO-pro-c算法，首次将带不确定性校准的专家乘积高斯过程模型作为贝叶斯优化的代理模型，在大幅降低计算成本、适用于大规模问题的同时保持了有竞争力的优化性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces BO-pro-c, a Bayesian optimisation algorithm that employs the uncertainty-calibrated product-of-experts Gaussian process model as its surrogate, achieving competitive optimisation performance at significantly reduced computational cost for large-scale problems.
